universal_lens: Athletic performance optimization through integrated physiological load, well-being, and readiness monitoring via Bayesian state-space models. Quantitative biomechanical modeling of spin kinematics in Wushu jump kicks using muscle contractility and arterial occlusion pressure metrics.
gsi_mapping: GSI infers training load thresholds using conformal predictive distributions over multi-variate physiological time-series data to optimize readiness states. gse_mapping: GSE executes dynamic state transitions in athlete training regimes based on real-time Bayesian inference of internal/external load and well-being signals. Situationally adaptive state transitions in Wushu performance based on real-time feedback loops integrating neuromuscular stiffness and joint angular velocity.
